bookmarkShelf.container.title: Bookmark Shelf
bookmarkShelf.view.name: Bookmarks
bookmarkShelf.welcome.unconfigured:
Browse, search, add and edit the bookmarks in your own Bookmark Shelf. You need a deployed Bookmark Shelf site and an app credential.
[Connect](command:bookmarkShelf.configure)
Not deployed yet? Follow these steps:
1. Open [lazyjerry/bookmark-shelf](https://github.com/lazyjerry/bookmark-shelf) on GitHub and press [Deploy to Cloudflare](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/lazyjerry/bookmark-shelf). Cloudflare creates the Worker and the D1 database; set AUTH_PASS (your login password) during deployment.
2. Sign in to the deployed site in a browser, open Settings → App credentials, enter your current password and a name such as "VS Code", then press Create.
3. Copy the username (starts with app-) and the password. The password is shown only once.
4. Press Connect above and enter the domain, username and password. The connection is tested before it is saved.
[Deployment Guide](command:bookmarkShelf.openDeployGuide)
bookmarkShelf.welcome.empty:
No bookmarks yet.
[Add Bookmark](command:bookmarkShelf.add)
You can also select a URL in the editor and choose "Add Selected URL to Bookmark Shelf" from the context menu.
